summary:
w240 (work-queue r62): the r62 Outline (features/work-queue.feature:92, 6 examples) is red on three undefined proposal Givens.
Plan: add those Givens in tests/scenarios/work_queue_status_steps.py. The done code path is already in place (notes).
Decision D1: a `merged` capability-proposal no longer counts as closed. Rests on r62 (formulated or withdrawn) and r47 (neither keeps started), with decision 0065 (merged became formulated). Verified that no open initiative has a merged proposal.
This adds scripts/workqueue_done.py (CLOSED_PROPOSAL, docstring) and tests/scripts/test_workqueue_done.py (the merged case rewritten to False) to the file set.
D2: the shared done rule for request delivery and work run stays as it is. No caller changes.
Retires the two @r23 deprecated scenarios. Open: step-pattern prefix overlap, proposal file naming.
